mechanism: Nalmefene may increase risk of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) in SGLT2 inhibitor users through opioid antagonism effects on glucose homeostasis and fluid balance.
action: Monitor for signs of DKA (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, polyuria); counsel patients on hydration and sick day management; consider alternative opioid antagonist if DKA risk factors present.
